notes.title: Divine Adventure Act One 1.2 Update!
notes.notes:
The next part of the adventure is here! 

Changelog:
[list]
[*] You can now continue the main story 
[*] Travel to another dimension
[*] Marry your first wife
[*] Meet your son
[*] Learn new abilities
[*] More!
[/list]

notes.title: Image fixes
notes.notes:
We apologise strongly for the image issues with some characters and backgrounds. We have had to change to much content to fit steam guidelines that we ended up with a few image errors. If you notice more, please let us know in the discussion section so we can fix it as soon as possible.

In this update we have fixed a number of major image issues that we can detect.

Thanks.

notes.title: Divine Adventure Act One officially released!
notes.notes:
Divine Adventure Act One is now officially released for WIndows and Mac! 
We hope you enjoy the project, join us in the discussion section for any questions!
Thanks!
